source_value.finding: The source is a ten-period nested budget with personnel, equipment, travel, participant support, other direct costs, indirect costs, attachments, and period/cumulative calculations.
Project/subaward type, the $5,000 equipment threshold, attachment overflow, and a single budget-justification attachment are material static and behavioral constraints.
Official metadata declares no separate instruction PDF, so calculation and policy meaning beyond the pinned XSD, DAT, and visible pages remains unaccepted.
